Bug_Details:
Using the standard getClassLoader() may not return the right class loader in a JEE context. Instead, go through the currentThread .
Noncompliant code example
ClassLoader cl = this.getClass().getClassLoader();  // Noncompliant
Compliant solution
ClassLoader cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using the non-compliant approach of obtaining the ClassLoader using this.getClass().getClassLoader() instead of the recommended Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() in a JEE context.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the ClassLoaderExample class, which uses the non-compliant approach of obtaining the ClassLoader using this.getClass().getClassLoader().
